convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for CoppockHist indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: long closed when CoppockHist[1]>CoppockHist[2] (histogram declining from peak), short closed when CoppockHist[1]<CoppockHist[2] (histogram rising from trough)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic requires histogram direction AND momentum: Long entry requires CoppockHist[1]<CoppockHist[2] (histogram rising/falling less) AND CoppockHist[0]>CoppockHist[1] (current value above previous, confirming momentum). SignalBar parameter offsets the bar index for signal calculation (default=1 means previous completed bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles to enable/disable each direction independently. Signal times are calculated as last bar date + timeframe seconds offset.
python_conversion_notes: The CoppockHist custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python: it computes ROC1(period=14) + ROC2(period=11) then smooths the sum with SMA(period=3). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position open/close with MoneyManagement modes - all this logic must be reimplemented. The Applied_price_ enum includes non-standard price types (Simpl=OC/2, Quartered=HLOC/4, TrendFollow_1, TrendFollow_2) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which require custom price calculation functions. SL/TP values are in points and likely need 5-digit adjustment (1000 points = 100 pips on 5-digit, 1000 pips on 4-digit - verify).
